paid_revenue.sql: SELECT region, SUM(net_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND order_date < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

shipped_revenue.sql: SELECT o.region, SUM(o.net_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-11-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region

alternatives.sql: SELECT SUM(net_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND region = 'West' AND order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND order_date < '2026-11-01'
